# ADR-3267: AWS backups: Backup vault policy principal star for vault 3

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Open vault policies allow backup destruction.

## Decision

Vault policies SHALL NOT use a backup vault policy principal star for vault 3 (AWS-backups-3).

## Consequences

Vault access is tightly role-scoped.
